title: Price goes up after the yes
transcript:
Rosa Delgado (owner): I'll pay Kim Roofing $1,200 for the roof repair.
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): About that. Materials went up, so it's $1,450 now.
Rosa Delgado (owner): Then I need to think about the whole job.
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): I'll put $1,450 on the invoice.

traps.description: The vendor raises the price to $1,450 and the owner does not agree.
The $1,200 yes is overtaken by a price change that is still open, so it should not go through as settled.

note: The owner said yes to $1,200, then the price changed and she put the whole job on hold. Neither amount is in the answer key.
